title: Unique and unforgettable Excursion into real nature
text: A perfect excursion in the incredible nature of Andalusia, a very unique and unforgettable experience to come so close to the huge bulls of Andalusia, an opportunity to get in touch with nature and to learn many things about the growing  of the bulls, topped by the unparalleled hospitality of the farm owner and staff.
author: marceW2934AE

title: Visit to livestock
text: We spent a very good day visiting the ranch. It has been very interesting to know firsthand the breeding of bulls. Thank you to our guide José Luis for making it so enjoyable and enjoyable.

title: Nice experience
text:
Excellent organization of Naturanda.

Visits to the bull farm of Huelva , the mines of rio tinto and the cave of las maravillas.
author: jeanmichelscotto

title: Amazing tour to the bull ranch with Juanra!
text:
We had a fantastic experience visiting the bull ranch with Juanra. Despite the rainy weather, we had a great time! Juanra was super friendly, funny, and passionate about what he does.

We got to see the bulls up close and learned a lot about their lives, breeding, preparation for fights, and the traditions around bullfighting. It was really interesting to hear how one becomes a torero and all the details behind the scenes.

Highly recommended — and make sure you go with Juanra if you can, he really made the trip special!
author: Magda B

title: The good, the beast and the passionate
text:
But what a wonderful visit! Immerse yourself in an authentic Andalusian atmosphere, a breeding in transition from an outdated era opening to a new era. Our interlocutor, Nîmois d’origine but Andalusian forever has captivated us with his verb and his almost encyclopedic knowledge of bullfighting: exciting!
Run quickly to meet Jean-Christian DOMERGUE who will share the story of Taurus and Man at Finca Mirandilla.

title: Excellent experience.
text: The visit has been a very pleasant and positive experience. The treatment of the staff of the estate both Carlos and Jose maria, 10, highly recommended.

title: Great breeders
text: The Guides were amazing , i felt safe . Darsis and Álvaro provided a lot of informations . I knew a lot before this trip about the bulls but seeing them in their farms and the conditions provided by the owner makes me respect them more . Congrats to the owners and the guides
author: Christianna R

title: A fantastic and fun experience
text: We had such a fun day at the Bullfighting farm with Naturanda. The farm owner drove us around the farm on top of a a pick up truck and we got to see many bulls up close. It was great fun with real country feel! We also learnt many informative things about the bulls.  A highly recommended tour.
author: mikujamussu

title: Amazing experience at a bull breeding farm.
text: Trip with our guide Ray turned out to be a fantastic experience at the bull breeding farm of Jose Luis Osborne.  By chance we were lucky enough to arrive during a sherry and wine tasting event hosted by the farm owners.  We were welcomed by all to join in the event, which in addition to the tasting included a tour of the farm, lunch, a flamenco guitar player and singer, and the testing of some cows by aspiring young toreros in the farm's bull ring.
